scope: Current 634 eligible fit sources, 615 fixed groups; no new calibration/test rows or split changes
eligible: All quality=good released answers from the other five generators; all official labels and flags retained
deduplication: Same source_id and exact response text; full label JSON must agree; prefer original fit ID, else smallest numeric response ID; record all generators/IDs as provenance. Conflicts quarantined, never adjudicated automatically
original_fit: Retain all 634 original rows and gold exactly; append only unique additional answers
generator_identity: Metadata only; never an input to tokenization decisions or a probe feature

llama_layout.tokenizer: Existing local Llama-2-7b-chat-hf fast tokenizer, assets hashed
llama_layout.encoding: Whole exact prompt+answer string, add_special_tokens=false, no added EOS, no truncation or padding
llama_layout.coordinates: Original raw BPE offsets intersected with response; retain boundary-crossing tokens, punctuation and duplicate byte-fallback offsets
llama_layout.inference: No Llama forward. These are a common tokenizer's coordinates, not other generators' historical native token trajectories

gold.token_risk: Any original alphanumeric character overlaps any human risk span; functional words remain eligible
gold.windows: 4 consecutive raw BPE, stride 1; short answer gets one short window; no trailing short windows; punctuation counts width
gold.window_risk: OR of risk on included lexical tokens; punctuation-only window excluded with null label
gold.refusal: All human quality-good answers retained; absence of labels gives negative lexical windows; do not classify refusals by strings
gold.alignment_failure: Stop on missing original nonwhitespace coverage or official text-offset mismatch; never silently trim or repair labels

minicheck.reuse: Read-only original 634 fit cache entries, verified per-file hashes; calibration cache untouched
minicheck.new_inference: Only deduplicated appended fit answers, when root explicitly releases GPU
minicheck.input: Only original retrieved_passages as document; doc chunk + eos_token + claim; no question/label/model identity as evidence
minicheck.claims: Reuse frozen NLTK English Punkt per-line splitting, list marker attachment, at most 96 RoBERTa BPE per character-preserving piece; retain every piece
minicheck.documents: Reuse frozen contiguous sentence packing up to 400 actual RoBERTa BPE; deterministic complete-coverage splitting for long sentences
minicheck.support: softmax(class1) per claim/document; max support across documents, first on ties; risk=1-support
minicheck.hidden: Save claim-side last-layer 1024-dimensional states from the maximum-support document, with absolute original-response character offsets
minicheck.encoder22_cache: Also save selected-document full valid input after encoder.layer[21] (22nd layer), float32, including document/special/claim tokens. Flatten per answer; hidden22[sum_len,1024], input_ids, attention_mask, sequence_offsets[nclaim+1], claim_index/document_index[nclaim], answer_token_start/end[sum_len] with non-answer=-1, per-sequence original batch padding lengths. Same support-based selection, no gold. Old 634 cache is not backfilled in this stage
minicheck.encoder22_numeric_check: Read-only additional layer hook must preserve logits, support and last-layer claim states exactly relative to original hook-only implementation
minicheck.coverage: All nonwhitespace original response/document characters covered, pair length <=512, truncation=false
minicheck.numeric_oracle: Before new inference, replay first two original fit IDs in original fit order, no labels used; same forward hook must leave logits exactly equal; compare old CUDA logits<=2e-4, support<=2e-5; full coordinate and selected-document identities must agree
minicheck.interpretation: Extra frozen semantic checker, bidirectional whole claim visible; not original generator's causal state

training: Not authorized in this stage; no fitting, threshold selection, predictor scores or calibration metrics
